notes.title: Vårrundan, Indie Assemble and Demo updates on the way
notes.content:
Dear friend,

It is well known that fairies are one of the most shy and timid magical creatures out there. So it is with great unease that I confess, I have not been still even though I have been hiding from you...

[h1]Kinnekulle Vårrundan[/h1]
I hesitate showing [b]The Merry Fairy[/b] at real life events. To be properly experienced, my enchanted cottage requires a calm and silent surrounding. However, I decided to participate at [url=https://motesplatskinnekulle.se/varrundan/][b]Kinnekulle Vårrundan[/b][/url], because this event is extra special. During the first weekend of May, all artisans around Fairyland are invited to open the doors to their workshops and many local folk come to experience two days of creativity, ingenuity and lots of great fika. What better way to showcase my little magical cottage? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/b1fd12893a95e8f840df1726cb20388d25c083ce.png[/img]

If you are one of the magical creatures that came to meet me, [i]Hi there[/i]! I hoped a handful of people might come, but no more than five or so. And yet as the sun caressed the part of Fairyland that I call the Wizards Meadow, I received visit after visit and filled my heart with delight and inspiration as I met so many creative, curious, ingenious kindred spirits! I hope you will consider contacting me. Right here on Steam is a great place and it helps me a lot, but any other way is great, too. I even fixed the links on my website,[url=https://themerryfairy.se/] [b]www.TheMerryFairy.se[/b][/url], and started to draft a kind of a very fairylike social media activity plan!  

[h1]Indie Assemble[/h1]
Meanwhile in the digital realm, more magic is happening! This Merry Fairy is very happy to partake in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737/sale/IndieAssemble][b]Indie Assemble[/b][/url], a global celebration of Indie Games curated with a lot of care and love by Excalibur.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/76695c647df7141a4812bf21ad4e5880c707c287.png[/img]

Indie Assemble features over 1,000 indie games from a wide variety of genres, made by over 600 game studios from no less that 63 countries around the world. “[i]The interest shown in Indie Assemble has been astounding[/i]” says Giorgio Catania, Founder of Excaliber and curator of the initiative. “[i]I wasn’t expecting such a massive response, but once word spread through the channels frequented by international indie developers, participation requests started pouring in nonstop. And since Excaliber’s mission is to foster the growth of the video game industry, with a particular focus on the indie scene, expanding the reach of the promotion as much as possible was a natural and spontaneous choice. Because, as I have learned from my many years of experience in the field, there is strength in unity.[/i]”
Thank you so very  much, Giorgio, for organizing this beautiful and very helpful event!

[h1]The Merry Fairy Demo update [/h1]
With so much going on socially, it almost feels like Vårrundan and Indie Assemble conspire to save the poor little bugs that found a nice and warm home in my latest build. I can, however, happily report that I did find quite a few of them, and guided them gently outside my cottage, where they belong. 
I am planning one last big update for [b]The Merry Fairy Demo[/b], before I focus my full and undivided attention towards the full game. The Demo update's greatest focus is on performance optimisation and bug fixing, but it does carry a bit of shiny new features and content as well.

[i]What, the public demo version is #35?!!![/i]

It's been a while since I gave the public version a try! Meanwhile, besides a lot of optimisation, stuff moved around a little bit in the cottage, fresh content appeared in the guestbook and the Decoration pages gained a bunch of extra buttons.

[previewyoutube=KViFIT0kvgg;full][/previewyoutube]

I still seek magical creatures to help me test the last Demo update. If this is you, please reach out right here on Steam, or [url=https://discord.gg/HCqxUzvEXP]on my Discord server[/url].

Thank you for reading this! 🌸🌸🌸


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/c494536a809f5c594089fe25d2cb66aebd57a7ac.png[/img]

notes.title: The magic of number 9
notes.content:
Dear friend,

Some time ago I wrote [url=https://gamespress.westeu-v2.propressroom.com/zh-CN/The-Merry-Fairy-Fairytale-Inspired-Scrapbook-Journal-Simulator-Arrives]a press release[/url] to announce the release date for[b] The Merry Fairy[/b]. But the thought of writing about it here did not cross my mind. I simply made the date available in the store front. For those of you who missed the tiny news, know this: 

I plan to launch The Merry Fairy on July 9, 2025. The full game will cost USD/ EUR 9.99. 

[h1]Why 9?[/h1]

I am turning 44 years old on July 9, 2025. For most of my life, I did not celebrate my birthday and did my best to think of this date as something unimportant. It was a subconscious ([i]or perhaps semi conscious[/i]) attempt to make myself small, to pretend that my existence matters little and to instil in myself some crocked pride and joy in my selflessness, as if my exercise in taking as little space as possible is something noble and worthy of love. 

I feel you might recognise the feeling. 

But somewhere down the adventurous road of my life, I learned that all life matters. There is nothing noble in putting myself down - in fact, the very opposite is true. If I cannot celebrate my own existence, what trust can I have in my ability to celebrate any life at all? 

This flipped a switch in me and about two years ago, I started to create the best birthday gift I can think of, for myself: [b]The Merry Fairy[/b]. I knew I'd launch this game on July 9th, I knew I am starved of birthday celebrations so I made myself a promise that I will give myself this gift as fast as I can, and I knew I'd want to price it at 9.99. Coincidentally, number 9 fits well in many more pragmatic ways, though I cannot help myself dreaming that the Universe spawned me with a key to my own heart and self love all along. 

So now you know: [b]The Merry Fairy[/b] is a very personal gift to myself. It will come on my birthday and it will offer precisely what I desire:  a mirror that can show me just how magical I am. A window into my own heart. A fairytale space that is quiet and safe, where I may find my joy by playing and exploring my creativity; where I may cry, allowing my shadows to dissipate into the light of these digital pages, imprinting my wisdom as they melt away; where I may just be, for it is and has always been enough. 

Curiously enough, though certainly not unexpected, the more I pour my soul into [b]The Merry Fairy[/b], the more the magic of [b]The Merry Fairy[/b] finds its way into my regular, every day life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/9cc45706f047d68f975eca54096c00eda8e7f428.png[/img]

The fact that this gift I am building for myself can be shared with you is, perhaps, my most favourite feature. Welcome into my world, my friend!

[h1]Help wanted[/h1]
Since I will launch [b]The Merry Fairy[/b] on July 9th, I will take part in the June edition of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. These kind of events are notorious for launching demos, but my demo has been out and about for a while, and I have been updating it on a fairly regular basis. I am preparing one last demo update which I plan to launch for Steam Next Fest. This update will contain:

[list]
[*] A much improved Decorations page in the journal, where you can sort the stickers you have gathered based on size and category
[*] The Decoration page will also contain a Clear All button, just in case you'd like to start over (I often do)
[*] A new page in the Guestbook, with brand new decorative and contemplative content
[*] A handful of visual improvements in the game scene
[*] A bunch of bug fixes
[*] A massive effort to improve the overall performance of the demo
[/list]
[b]I seek help![/b]

If you find yourself having a few minutes to spare, I'd love some extra hands to test all these new features and fixes before I launch the latest demo version publicly. I can be reached via Steam (I prepared [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2364180/discussions/0/592892850991037300/][b]a topic on the forum[/b][/url] so that you can easily express your interest) or Discord (I made a server for The Merry Fairy [url=https://discord.gg/hjUAE8RbKZ][b]right here[/b][/url]). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/c494536a809f5c594089fe25d2cb66aebd57a7ac.png[/img]

notes.title: A tribute to Rumi
notes.content:
Dear friend, 

We live in uncertain times. I do my best to find solace by hugging Kindness, Wisdom and Friendship, my old beech friends by the edge of my beloved forest. But sometimes the worry cannot be helped. And it is right to embrace fear these days, when the winter still lets the icy darkness linger, and when the darkness of our times threatens to conquer all of us. 

"[i]If everything around you seems dark, look again. You may be the light[/i]" said Rumi, a 13th century poet whose wise and loving words echo in my heart with such strength, that it feels he is still alive, visiting me in Fairyland right now. 

I thought you might need the gentle wisdom of his words, too.

So I made a new build, featuring some of my most favourite Rumi quotes, though I can assure you, many more will follow. They are accompanied by a few decorations I have been craving for quite some time now: 
[list]
[*] three types of lace ([i]be weary, one is kinda buggy and I do not yet know why[/i])
[*] stars and the moon
[*] more backgrounds, especially darker ones, so its easier to design darker, moodier journal spreads
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/0a35347f1c3d2bc5456faf49e2b8c40693c063a6.jpg[/img]

Build 35 also includes a few bug fixes, most notably the necessary lighting fix which has been dulled down for a few good builds now. 

I leave you with a few pictures of my frozen Fairyland:

notes.title: The Merry Fairy has a build update for the Steam Idler Fest
notes.content:
Dear friend,

It is with great joy to let you know that The Merry Fairy is taking part in the Steam Idler Fest! This is my first Steam Fest so I am not sure what to expect, but I could not miss the chance to launch an update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/f59fbf0b00101a1c9cb26388960e2b9a3687202f.jpg[/img]

With build 34, you can now choose from several font options and you can also customise the colour of your journal entries. I have prepared 7 font options and made 8 font colours available. Some are darker to work well with light backgrounds and some are whiter ([i]there is, in fact, an almost white one[/i]) to work well with darker backgrounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/436a940090e2d7ede0c33f6cd84d16d447d9ddc2.jpg[/img]

There are other changes, too, but they are kinda boring to talk about, as they are more to make the journaling experience at The Merry Fairy more enjoyable and to make room for more features to come. 
Instead of writing boring development updates, I'd rather tell you about....

[h2]Fairy Socks and other projects![/h2]

It took me a while to feel comfortable accepting this, but I no longer identify as a game developer. My heart feels happier with the identity of an artist. The Merry Fairy is one of many ways in which I can express myself - which, to me, is the same with spreading my wings and flying high! 

Other ways in which I find joy expressing are: 
[list]
[*] [b]Cooking [/b]- making food is an art where the colours are replaced by flavours
[*] [b]Crochet [/b]- turning a simple thread into a fun, wearable or usable item is nothing short of magic
[*] [b]Sewing [/b]- there are very few options of clothes for fairies, so I feel compelled to make my own
[*] [b]Gardening [/b]- growing your own food is a very satisfying activity 
[*] [b]Foraging [/b]- the forest is always so generous
[*] [b]Woodworking [/b]- I have not yet started ion this journey, but my creativity needs a unique kind of furniture and the forest is more than generous with material for me
[/list]
I am pretty sure that my curiosity will be stirred by many more things in my lifetime, and I am eager to learn how you, dear kindred spirit, enjoy expressing yourself! Which is why I started the lonely work of updating [url=https://discord.gg/hjUAE8RbKZ][b]The Merry Fairy Discord server[/b][/url], where, besides more elaborate updates about the development of this game, you will find my favourite recipes, my crochet patterns, lots of pictures with my garden, and more.

What about Fairy Socks, you may wonder. Well, it is well known that fairies tend to have very cold feet. For many moons, I searched for a good solution to no longer freeze, especially during the cold dark Swedish winter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/a798588c6b85a992a101b9aefca1dc90e42d849b.png[/img]

One day, the Caretaker told me about an extraordinary encounter: a group of Yarn Fairies had made Fairyland their home! I think it is because of our lovely sheep, whose wool has not been used by anyone. I could not believe it at first, but testing whether you have Yarn Fairies or not is easy: if you sleep with a little bit of scrap yarn under your pillow, they gently replace it with a whole skew of yarn. 

It turns out the Caretaker was right! Fairyland does have Yarn Fairies and I ended up with a really generous collection of thick sheep wool. I experimented a little bit with some vests and scarfs, but one day, my hands just made a pair of socks. They were the warmest, cosiest socks I ever wore. Finally, I found my Fairy Socks! They were so cozy, that I made a pair for the Caretaker, too. One by one, the entire Fairyland got a pair of socks from me. 

I got so good at making Fairy Socks and I have so much wool from the Yarn Fairies, that I decided to participate at the local handicraft fair that takes place each spring. I now build up my Fairy Socks stock and prepare The Merry Fairy game, which will also be showcased. I already am having a lot of fun with this plan and I really hope I can sell all the socks I will make by spring. If you are into crochet as well, I did my best to explain the Fairy Socks crochet pattern on my Discord server. And if you happen to be around Kinnekulle in the first weekend of May, take a tour at [url=https://motesplatskinnekulle.se/varrundan/]Vårrundan[/url] and visit [url=https://motesplatskinnekulle.se/profile/TheMerryFairy/]The Merry Fairy[/url] aka me (websites are in Swedish).

Other than developing The Merry Fairy and making Fairy Socks, I am eagerly planning for this summer's gardening. 2025 is a special year to me because I am finally daring to try to grow aubergines once again. It is a courageous act, as my first attempt a few years ago resulted in a lot of work and one single ripe aubergine to pick. Besides aubergines, I will also grow tomatoes, cucumbers, paprika, zucchini, beetroots, onions, beans, salad, a variety of condiments and a lot of flowers. In fact, I gave myself a very early start and already seeded a few!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/573f9cbbf8d4c90fdf22d45aa12e329186ee7e81.png[/img]

With so many exciting projects, the only risk remains that I forget to be in the present. And the present is such a gift! I don't know about you, but I always fall in love with the current season. Right now, we are going through a long, dark, cold Nordic winter. She is not many's favourite, but I cannot help but be amazed by her sparkling beauty! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/c54d934d45d3e509e22410794d5fcbf5cc9d616b.jpg[/img]

Yours, 
Fairy

notes.title: A small update for The Merry Fairy demo
notes.content:
Dear friend,

It is Halloween soon, one of my most favourite holiday because I get to carve pumpkins and freely show my wings 𓆩♡𓆪. I wish this would have been build update no. 13 but... I am able to do the next best thing, which is build update no. 31! Here is what is in it:

[list]
[*] A request for you to allow my Unity Analytics to track a bit of your behaviour. You can absolutely decline it, but even if you accept it you can rest assured that your information remains safe and will be seen by your eyes alone. I will never be able to see, nor ever want to see your journal entries, unless you are extra proud of them and would like to share screenshots on the community hub. What would help me to know is how long you spend at my cottage, how often you visit, how many journal pages you fill and especially how many stickers you use! This is because I want to make sure you will have the tools to organize and easily find everything you gather later. By keeping a close eye on the aggregated behaviour of all of you magical creatures, I can get a little bit of a silent guiding from you, to make your stay at The Merry Fairy as comfortable as possible. 
[*] The Guestbook now has pages that flip, yay!
[*] The stickers can now be rotated much, much much more finely, which is something I've been meaning to add for So Long!
[/list]

This is it! I leave you with a picture of one of my tree friends, a very old oak whose beauty greets my misty mornings: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/f2f1152de514e26cc14e8a1f95dbd9bf7eec78fd.jpg[/img]

Yours, 
Fairy

notes.title: The Merry Fairy Demo has been updated!
notes.content:
Dear friend,

Autumn stole my heart and my focus with its incredible beauty and generosity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/86805a6fd21ef79844a4584e34c290a7f3f69d0d.jpg[/img]

But I stole a few moments back from her to myself, and I gift these moments to you. I made an update for you, filled with love, abundance and cozy vibes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/6b09223590cd4c28e45ea448584ab3cf2591b01f.png[/img]

[b]The Merry Fairy Demo is now updated to version 30[/b] and it contains ([i]from what I can remember, for fairies have little time for mundane tasks such as taking notes or keeping accurate lists[/i]) the following:

[list]
[*] A much needed fix for when the mouse cursor disappears, especially when you add freeform text
[*] A brand new Guestbook page, filled with cozy decorations to celebrate autumn* 
[*] Additional and much needed sizes for when using Windowed mode (accessible from the Main Menu Settings)
[*] An improved lighting mood for rainy and stormy weather: I dimmed the main lights, so that you can light the candles and turn the lantern on, if you wish!
[*] New sound effects, especially for when you write down your thoughts - I find them so satisfying!
[/list]

I am pretty sure there's more, but the best way to find out is to simply visit my enchanted cottage. Meanwhile...

[b][h2]The Merry Fairy Tik Tok account[/h2][/b]
I must admit, my friend, that I have been very suspicious about posting on [i]social media[/i]. But autumn convinced me to give it a try. So now I have a [b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@the_merry_fairy][b]Tik Tok account[/b][/url][/b] where I can show you my magical forest and all that inspires [b]The Merry Fairy[/b]. I speak very little about the game itself and very much about magic and fairies and trees and life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/290681e210f8887215a49e3f991480d079d3fc2c.png[/img]

I am horrendously bad at it, so please expect text in annoying places, lack of covers and muffled speech because I forget how to hold my phone. I suppose I can only get better! How wonderful it is to learn something new! I am having a lot of fun! I would love your company on Tik Tok!

This is it, for now! There may be more demo updates coming soon, but  while you wait, my friend, I hope you go outside and enjoy this beautiful autumn, if you can ❤️

Yours, 
Fairy

notes.title: Introducing the Fairyland tour!
notes.content:
Dear friend,

I am so excited to let you know that I have an update for you! The new version of [b]The Merry Fairy Demo[/b] is now [b]29[/b] and it includes the following:

[list]
[*] [b]Subtitles for the introductory video![/b] This is something that makes me extra happy to present, as it is something I have never done before. But now I learned and this made me very happy! I hope the font and the colour choices allow you to read the subtitles comfortably.
[*] [b]A little bit of volume control![/b] This is far from perfect and only available in the main Settings that you can access from outside the cottage, but you can now lower the overall volume for The Merry Fairy
[*] [b]A brand new mushroom! [/b]I experimented with many ways to enchant the mouse cursor, including many leaves and even a lilac branch ([i]lilac is my most favourite flower![/i]). But in the end, the mushroom won!
[*] [b]A much requested tour![/b] When you first come to The Merry Fairy, the Caretaker will now welcome you immediately and offer a tour (or tutorial). You can also ask for a tour of The Merry Fairy via the bell that is on your desk.
[*] [b]A better way to talk to Fairy's whimsical friends![/b] Previously, it was very easy to exit the current dialogue by clicking anywhere outside the dialogue window, such as clicking on the character portraits. This will no longer happen. You can still exit by clicking anywhere outside the dialogue area, but this area is bigger now and it includes the character portrait.
[*] [b]Updated dialogues[/b] - this is probably something I will continue to change and tweak until the end of times. Please give me feedback about the visits you are getting from my whimsical friends and what you think about their chatter! It is the only way I'll manage to edit them [i]less[/i]!
[*] [b]Dev menu accessible using the F5 key now![/b] This is more important than it sounds, I think, since F12 is the default Steam key for screenshots. 
[*] [b]Some lightning improvements[/b] but there is still some flickering left. 
[*] [b]Tiny new sounds[/b] that feel a little better for when someone knocks on your window
[/list]

There is also an [b]unwanted behaviour in version 29[/b]. In theory, the Caretaker will welcome you at the start of the visit and then come back half an hour later to check up on you. But for now, he wants to visit you right away. I think he is simply too excited about your visit!

I hope you will enjoy this update and please continue to give me feedback! 

I would also very much love to see what you create in your journals, if you would like to share your screenshots in The Merry Fairy community hub! And if you have wishes for any specific decorations, I would love to know ❤

Yours, 

Fairy

notes.title: An ode to autumn (and planned updates for the demo)
notes.content:
Dear friend,


This week I noticed the first signs of autumn. I usually have an inner resistance to admit the end of summer, but the past few days have been chillier and splashes of red and yellow started to pop on the forest floor. To my surprise, I found my heart happy at the thought! I long for the symphony of autumn colors, for wearing cozy woolen sweaters and boots and for observing a change that, in the past, I have mistaken for some sort of loss. It is not a loss though, nor a sad end. It is a transformation. Life is in a constant process of transformation. 

I hope for an inspired and productive autumn and frankly, I could not have gotten a better start. This is thanks to you, who played [b]The Merry Fairy Demo[/b], who gave me extraordinary encouraging and helpful feedback, and you who wishlisted my game. 

[previewyoutube=Ht1QLIIx6aM;full]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ht1QLIIx6aM[/previewyoutube]

I underestimated the toll it takes to show a project as personal and intimate as [b]The Merry Fairy[/b] to the world. I am so grateful for the gentleness I experienced and for the fact that it seems I got my idea across. I dearly wish for [b]The Merry Fairy[/b] to give only oxytocin and serotonin to you and to me, as I further create it! Please keep your feedback coming, knowing that I am listening to you with care and joy. 

[b][h2]The Merry Fairy Demo updates[/h2][/b]
Listening and watching you play, I realized some of the blinders I unwillingly inherited as a creator. I welcomed you to [b]The Merry Fairy[/b] as if we were old, old friends, assuming that you know where everything is and how everything works in my tiny, cozy home. But we are new friends and I have been an absent-minded host. Well, I am fixing this now, and preparing a [u][b]demo update that I hope to release sometime next week[/b][/u]. Here is what I hope it will contain:

[list]
[*] Subtitles for the intro video
[*] Improvements for the mouse cursor, which sometimes disappears after using the freeform text entry in the journal
[*] Maybe even a cute cursor skin!
[*] A volume slider for the music
[*] A small tutorial designed as a mandatory Caretaker visit, so he can welcome you properly to Fairyland and explain how everything works and what to expect
[*] The tutorial will be skippable, but that line for dialogues will be available via the bell
[*] The development menu will stay but be changed to some other key than F12, which I forgot is the default key for screenshots 
[*] A lighting improvement so that there is less flickering when the short candle by the stained glass window is lit
[*] A gentler way to exit the dialogues - right now, if you click anywhere outside the dialogue window, you exit it and lose the current conversation. I do believe dialogues, in general, need an improved design, but as a quick fix for now, I will make it so if you click  on the character, you will not exit the dialogue - you will exit only if you click somewhere way outside the dialogue or the X button
[/list]

Please do not take this list as a promise! I want to release an update next week no matter what. I will of course provide a clear and reliable list of changes then. 

[b][h2]The future of The Merry Fairy[/h2][/b]
My shyness stood in the way of me being clear with my plans. I did launch [b]The Merry Fairy Demo[/b] in a bit of a rush, due the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration event, and I did not really think much beyond that. But now that I have started to get your feedback, I know what I wish to do!

[b]I have no intention to deactivate the Demo[/b]. I will keep it live and available for you at the very least until I really polish the features available in it. However, I do have a big worry. I know how important and personal a journal can be. If you continue to use the enchanted journal I prepared for you, please know that your work may be lost as I continue to update [b]The Merry Fairy[/b]. I will be very careful with this and let you know when an update might endanger your saves, but this is not a very reliable solution. 

[b] The Merry Fairy Demo[/b] will get improvements and a bit more content, but no new features or characters. For the entire project, I plan to have more things to do and there are seven of my whimsical friends who really want to meet you. I will progressively reveal my plans here and on my social media, so I hope you will enjoy to tag along and keep me company. Here is where you can find me:
[list]
[*] [b]On [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2364180]The Merry Fairy Steam community hub[/url][/b]: I keep an eye daily for new comments and discussions
[*] [b]On Discord[/b]: I have a small and very peaceful server [url=https://discord.gg/hjUAE8RbKZ]here[/url]
[*] [b] On YouTube[/b]: I made a [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TheMerryFairy]YouTube channel for The Merry Fairy[/url] and update it occasionally
[*] [b]On Tik Tok[/b]: I also made a [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@the_merry_fairy]Tik Tok account for The Merry Fairy[/url], but for some reason, of all social media, Tik Tok really triggers y social anxiety. However, I do very much intend to get out of my comfort zone and post there, especially since more than a few people mentioned that my voice sounds like Björk!!!
[/list]

I also have [url=https://x.com/TheMerryFairy]a very small Twitter presence[/url] but I am not sure I will keep it - I do not enjoy that platform. 

I hope to release [b]The Merry Fairy[/b] next summer. I hesitate to make this information too public since I know all too well how such plans can fail, but I do aim for that which is why I am very careful about keeping The Merry Fairy contained. However, your entire stay at The Merry Fairy is planned for one summer month, which means 30 days, and can continue indefinitely as long as you don't get too lonely. 

Once again, thank you, my friend!

Yours,

Laura aka Fairy

notes.title: Play The Merry Fairy Demo now!
notes.content:
Dear friend,


[b]The Merry Fairy Demo[/b] is finally ready to play on Steam! Come spend a little time at my beautiful cottage and enjoy the Fairyland vibe. Here is what you can expect:

[list]
[*] A beautiful scrapbook journal ready for your thoughts and creativity
[*] Various decorations that you can gather from all kinds of places, such as the Guestbook (but there are hidden decorations, too!)
[*] Two of Fairy's whimsical friends, Jack the Caretaker and Lekkote the Wishtree, ready to visit you every half an hour and talk about magic and matters of the heart
[*] A few letters from Fairy
[*] A friendly weather that follows your wishes 
[*] Candles, a soothing windchime and a tiny companion
[/list]

I have been fussing the entire night before opening the doors for your visit. I might have left a thing or two extra, for your visit, and perhaps not everything is fully built and polished. I do welcome every thought and wish you have, as I do desire to make your stay as comfortable as possible. 

I launched [b]The Merry Fairy Demo[/b] with the occasion of the [b]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/b] fest. Depending on the kind of feedback I will receive from you, I may have to close The Merry Fairy Demo on occasion. So please try out the enchanted scrapbook journal well aware that you might lose your beautiful entries and creations. 


Enjoy The Merry Fairy!

Yours, 
Fairy

notes.title: The Merry Fairy demo comes on August 15, to celebrate Wholesome Games!
notes.content:
Dear friend,

It is with great joy that I announce [b]The Merry Fairy[/b]'s participation at the wonderful[b] Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/b] event, which will take place [b]starting August 15 and until August 21[/b].

[b]The Merry Fairy[/b] will participate with a shiny demo, where you, my friend, will be invited to spend [b]a few days [/b]at Fairy's enchanted cottage in the middle of Fairyland. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097128/aa7a1102a6252a584e9323456d5182074f1bc01a.png[/img]

If you would like to visit [b]The Merry Fairy[/b] during the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration, here is what you need to know:
[list]
[*] One day in Fairyland lasts 5 hours by the way humans count
[*] You will notice a curious thing, which is that you can control the weather - this is because Fairy asked the weather to kindly follow the wants and needs of your heart! So you will start every day in Fairyland by choosing the weather that suits your heart best
[*] Every day, you will find a nice letter from Fairy on your desk! And it is good to know that Fairy loves to give small gifts with every occasion 
[*] An enchanted journal already awaits you, ready to safe-keep the deepest of your thoughts
[*] Decorations will also be readily available to gather from various places and adorn the pages of your journal as you wish
[*] You will be able to browse the Guest Book, with doodles and interesting thoughts from a few of Fairy's former guests
[*] Every 30 minutes, the Caretaker or the Wishtree will knock on your window to see if you would like a little company. They have a lot of wonderful stories to tell - about Fairyland, about Fairy, about magic and about hope!
[/list]

Perhaps there will be more delights to discover! But some things are best left untold. 

I will now go back and tend to the exciting preparations needed for my cottage. Keep an eye out for a shiny new The Merry Fairy Demo page on Steam, which I hope to launch in the next few days!

Yours,

Fairy
